race.comment: MINDGAMES (5) was as expected on debut as a juvenile, and then was well placed when cruising home fresh up to score at Goulburn 11 days ago in a modest class 1 field over 1400m. He has come through that run unscathed, and is the one to beat again. OUTTA LINE (6) resumed in a tougher field at Rosehill just over 2 weeks ago, needing the run, finishing sixth over 1300m. The extra 300m is the key for us, and with a dip in grade, she will be a quick improver with some luck off a wide gate. WALLACE STATION (10) made it 2 wins from just 3 starts when scoring an all the way win here a fortnight ago. He cops an extra 2kg, but looks capable of working his way through the grades this season. GLASTONBURY (4) is a consistent mare and an extra 300m will suit her at this stage of her prep. Include in all top 4 combos.
